name: glyphh_bot
description: One of the Glyphh server's hosted bots, run on this rrotor. agent: one Claude Agent SDK conversation turn on the org's Anthropic key, its tools the server's, the folders' files and its plugins' scripts. run (older servers): the Glyphh SDK's runner walking the bot's loop. Called by the server over the link.

code.description: A code step of a program the server walks (rrotor 0.10.0): one function of the program's program.py, called with the step's input in this run's sandbox, in a process of its own given none of this program's secrets; the Result is what it returned (data.result, JSON) and what it printed, or failed with why

given.description: The step's input: the function's one argument

run.description: One go of the bot: from its first step, or (with answer) the run that waited carried on; each question it asks waits as needs_input; the Result carries the run, its state among it

package.description: The bot's files by path: bot.json (an object or its text), agent.md, skills/<name>/SKILL.md; no code

state.description: The runner's state (its runs.sqlite, base64) the last go left; null for a bot's first

given.description: What the run is given to work on ($input to its steps)

answer.description: The person's answer to the run that waits in state (one of its options, or a batch's map): carries it on instead of starting a run

model.description: opus, sonnet, haiku or a model id; agent.md's own wins

claude.description: api (the default): the Claude API on the secret ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; cli: Claude Code signed in on this rrotor

effort.description: How hard Claude works on its agent steps (the Claude API's output_config.effort; api only): left out, or on a model that takes none, the model's own default

file_tools.description: true: with folders given (the call's folders) and claude api, each agent step works with those folders' files in a loop of tool use (list, read, search, write, move; no delete, no shell), a change made only on the server's word (its tool file_change); the Result names the files read and changed (data.files) and never what is in them

agent.description: A bot's run as one Claude Agent SDK conversation turn (rrotor 0.9.0): the agent's only tools are the server-side tools named here, the files of the folders given and a plugin's declared scripts; a question the server stops it with waits as needs_input, and a continue (or a call with resume) carries the same session on; the Result is the agent's final words, the tools it used, the files it named and its tokens

message.description: What the person typed, the bot's standing task, or (with resume) the words that say what they answered

tools.description: The server-side tools: each call is POST tool_url {tool, input}, answered {result}, {error} or {ask: true} (the server stopped the run with its question)

plugins.description: The bot's Claude plugins, written into the run's folder: its files by path, and the scripts of it the agent may run with run_script

model.description: opus, sonnet, haiku or a model id

tokens.description: The whole run's tokens, input and output

resume.description: true: the run waited and was answered; carried on from the session kept on this rrotor when it is still here, else begun again from message

claude.description: api: Claude Code on the secret ANTHROPIC_API_KEY

file_tools.description: true: with folders given, the agent has the files of those folders (list, read, search, write, move), a change made only on the server's word (its tool file_change)
